sections.title: Core Banking Solutions (CBS)
sections.definition: CORE stands for 'Centralized Online Real-time Electronic' banking. Enables customers to access their bank account and perform basic transactions from any branch on the bank's network.

majorCbsPlatforms.usedBy: State Bank of India (SBI), Punjab National Bank (PNB), Bank of Baroda (BOB), Union Bank
Central Bank of India, Indian Bank, several Regional Rural Banks (RRBs)
HDFC Bank, Yes Bank, RBL Bank

sections.title: Indian Payment Systems Comparison Matrix
sections.hindiTitle: भारतीय भुगतान प्रणालियों की तुलनात्मक तालिका

systems.timing: 24x7x365 (half-hourly batches; 48 batches per day since Dec 2019)
systems.limits: Minimum: ₹1 | Maximum: No ceiling set by RBI (bank specific)
systems.features: Supports cash remittance to Nepal under Indo-Nepal Remittance Scheme

systems.settlement: Real-time instant interbank electronic fund transfer
systems.limits: Minimum: ₹1 | Maximum: ₹5,00,000 (increased from ₹2 lakh in Oct 2021)
systems.channels: Mobile banking, internet banking, ATMs, SMS, MMID (Mobile Money Identifier - 7 digits)

systems.addressing: Virtual Payment Address (VPA / UPI ID - e.g., user@sbi)
systems.limits: Standard: ₹1,00,000 per day; ₹5,00,000 for hospitals, educational institutions, IPO, and RBI Retail Direct schemes.
systems.protocols: Built on IMPS rails, uses 2-factor authentication (UPI PIN)

systems.services: Cash withdrawal, cash deposit, balance enquiry, Aadhaar to Aadhaar fund transfer, mini statement
systems.requirements: IIN (Issuer Identification Number), Aadhaar number, Biometric fingerprint/iris

systems.definition: Online image-based cheque clearing process. Physical cheque is truncated at collecting bank; digital image and MICR data transmitted electronically.
systems.micrCode: 9-digit numeric code on cheque bottom: First 3 digits = City code, Middle 3 digits = Bank code, Last 3 digits = Branch code.

features.security: Low - Static data stored on magnetic tape easily cloned using skimmers (discontinued for issuance).
High - Europay, MasterCard, Visa standard. Microchip creates dynamic unique cryptogram for every single transaction.
Uses Near Field Communication (RFID 13.56 MHz). Tap-and-go payment without PIN up to ₹5,000 in India.
Card Verification Value (3 digits on back of Visa/MasterCard/RuPay; 4 digits on front of American Express). Never stored by merchants under RBI Tokenization guidelines.
RBI mandate replacing actual 16-digit Card Number with an alternate unique code called 'Token' tied to specific merchant and device.

sections.title: RBI Cybersecurity Framework for Banks
sections.hindiTitle: बैंकों हेतु RBI साइबर सुरक्षा ढाँचा

guidelines.title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
guidelines.detail: Independent officer reporting directly to the Risk Committee of the Board.

guidelines.title: Security Operations Centre (SOC)
guidelines.detail: Mandatory 24x7 monitoring and incident detection infrastructure.

guidelines.title: Incident Reporting Timeline
guidelines.detail: Banks MUST report any cyber security incident to RBI within 2 to 6 hours of detection, and to CERT-In within 6 hours.

guidelines.title: Customer Liability Circular
guidelines.detail: Zero liability for customer if fraudulent unauthorized electronic transaction is reported within 3 working days.
